name: Natsuiro no Koware Mono
source:
Your childhood friend Ryouka Enomoto is the ace of the basketball team at your countryside school. Growing up together in such a small rural area, you naturally fell in love with her. However, after you have to move to the city, you can only return to stay with her in the summer. When you come back...

While spending the summer with your childhood friend, she is bedded by other men from under your nose in naturally occurring cucking events. Pervy middle-aged men, vagrants, bullied students, lusty students, loner virgins, delinquents, and more...

You have various ways to find out what she's getting up to.

translation:
你儿时的朋友榎本良香是你们乡村学校篮球队的王牌球员。在这样一个小农村一起长大，你自然而然地爱上了她。然而，当你必须搬到城市后，你只能在夏天回来和她住在一起。当你回来的时候…

当你和你儿时的朋友一起度过夏天时，她会在你眼皮子底下被其他男人上床，自然而然地发生口交事件。变态中年男人、流浪汉、被欺负的学生、好色的学生、独来独往的处女、不良少年等等……

你可以通过多种方式了解她的动态。
